I recomputed the comparison independently in Python from the original xlsx (sheet DEG). The sheet has 13,856 Ensembl rows plus one blank separator row, no duplicate IDs, and 263 rows with FDR<0.05. Joining through the feature map gave the same exclusions: 374 IDs with no symbol, 15 IDs in symbols summed over several features, 0 symbols shared by two author IDs, and 283 genes absent from the registered table. Results:
- Pairs: 13,184, which is 95.15% of 13,856 author rows and 99.27% of 13,281 registered rows.
- Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, direction agreement 12,525/13,184 (0.950015).
- Median absolute difference 0.014146, RMS ratio 0.901098.
- Author F-test DEG scope: 258 pairs, Pearson 0.986937, 100% direction agreement.

All of these match the claim exactly. author-effects.tsv agrees with the xlsx and with the current DE table to within 1e-16.

- Joining on the author geneSymbol column: 11,468 pairs, Pearson 0.9432, Spearman 0.9575.

The paper (PMC7491139, DOI 10.1186/s12864-020-07050-7) confirms the setup:
- 52 mice
- 13,856 genes kept by a mean ≥10 counts filter
- TMM normalization and limma
- time-matched SDep-vs-SS contrasts at 3, 6, 9 and 12 h combined in a moderated F-test

So SDvsSS_6hr.FC is the per-timepoint ZT6 coefficient, in the same orientation as the registered track (Hspa8: +0.444 author, +0.455 registered).

Under policy author-concordance-v2 the comparison passes. Registered coverage is 99.27% against the 0.9 minimum. Both correlations are at least 0.9, and direction agreement passes with 13,184 nonzero pairs. Magnitude also passes: median difference 0.014 against a 0.25 limit, and RMS ratio 0.90 within the allowed two-thirds to 1.5.

I parsed the xlsx independently with openpyxl, not the agent's dump. It has 431 unique Ensembl rows; 430 have padj<0.1 and the maximum padj is 0.10010. The minimum |LFC| is 0.290, so the "Fold>2" label is not a real filter. log2FoldChange has 166 positive and 265 negative values. log2FoldChange vs log2(mean CS/mean HFS) of the table's own per-library columns gives Pearson 1.0000 and 100% sign agreement. No other group pair exceeds 0.92. Negating to HFS minus CS is therefore correct, and the registered effects correlate positively (+0.90) with the negated values.

I re-implemented the exact-Ensembl join through the feature map: status mapped, symbol backed by a single feature, symbol present in the registered DE. Results: 406/431 paired (coverage 0.9420). Unpaired: 21 dropped_no_symbol, 1 summed (Mettl7a feature mapping to Tmt1a), 3 absent (Ptbp2, Prkcb, Atf3). Nonzero direction agreement 402/406; the discordant genes are Vsnl1, Ndufs1, Clasp2 and Myl9, all with local |logFC|<0.1 and local FDR>0.98. Pearson 0.8976, Spearman 0.9026, OLS slope (local on author) 0.4462. Median |LFC| is 0.8059 for the author and 0.4075 locally. 145 of 145 pairs with author |LFC|>=1 agree in direction. Author padj<0.1 for 405 paired genes versus 0 locally (minimum local padj 0.2879); 86 paired genes have local raw P<0.05. The symbol-route sensitivity gives 391 pairs, Pearson 0.8952, Spearman 0.8996, 387/391 directions. The symbol route would mis-pair Gad2: the author feature is ENSRNOG00000018200 and the registered Gad2 is ENSRNOG00000017803.
